reviews.title: you’re better off with NameHatch
reviews.text: This is the only app that looks 21st century, kind of. But it has random upgrades for 99 cent that people don’t need. A lot of people say the names are uninteresting and super unusual to choose. That’s why a lot are switching to NameHatch and finding the perfect name in days not months.
